I need to determine the correct founding year of the Juilliard School.

The Juilliard School has a complex history. The Institute of Musical Art was founded in 1905 by Frank Damrosch. In 1919, Augustus Juilliard died and left a bequest that led to the creation of the Juilliard Graduate School in 1924. These two institutions merged in 1926 to form what became known as the Juilliard School of Music (later just "The Juilliard School").

So there are multiple relevant dates:
- 1905: Institute of Musical Art founded (the predecessor)
- 1924: Juilliard Graduate School established
- 1926: The merger creating the Juilliard School

The question asks when "the Juilliard School" was founded. The institution bearing the Juilliard
